offence: Alleged breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 1 was released from its pit stop station when Car 4 was approaching. There is a possibility that Car 1 hindered Car 4 on its approach to the pit stop. However, Article 34.14 a) specifies that a car is considered to be released in an unsafe manner if it could endanger pit lane personnel or another driver. This was not the case and therefore no further action is taken.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 1 Alleged Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
